exampleId.note: A made-up OAuth 2 provider for the demo: no real client id or secret. Scenarios play its answers as the providerSignedIn and providerFailed actions.

computed.changeError: {{length(state.change.password) < 8 ? t('min8') : merge({ score: 0, label: '', missing: [] }, passwordStrength(state.change.password)).score < 2 ? t('stronger') : !state.showPassword && state.change.confirm != state.change.password ? t('mismatch') : ''}}
computed.usernameStatus: {{length(trim(state.username)) == 0 ? '' : length(trim(state.username)) < 3 || length(trim(state.username)) > 20 || !every(split(lower(trim(state.username)), ''), contains('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_.', it)) ? 'invalid' : state.usernameChecked != lower(trim(state.username)) ? 'checking' : contains(['ada', 'sam', 'admin'], state.usernameChecked) ? 'taken' : 'available'}}

checkedField.note: A field with an icon, an accessible name and its error under it once its form was submitted (the error is also the field's description, read out as an alert); secret ones show dots and, with eye, a button to show them. params: bind, content, key, icon, name, placeholder, valid, message, submitted, secret, eye, maxLength, submit (the action Enter runs)

strengthMeter.note: The passwordMeter with the screen's words and colours, and a hint of what would make the password stronger. params: password

children.text: {{length(password) == 0 ? t('strengthHint') : length(s.missing) == 0 ? t('strengthDone') : t('strengthAdd', { list: formatList(map(s.missing, t('missingItem', { what: it })), 'and') })}}

passwordRules.note: What a new password needs, each ticked off as it is met. params: password

notify.note: with: message. A toast in the corner for a few seconds

warnSession.note: A toast that offers to stay signed in, for longer than the others

serverCall.note: with: op (the action that answers), what (what is busy). The fake server: answers at once, or after 800 ms when Slow network is on. state.busy marks the busy button and the status line.

lookup.note: The identifier step: is there an account for this email? The password step follows
The email field is gone on this step, so the first field is the password

then.note: Five wrong passwords in a row lock the account until its password is reset

finishCreate.note: The account waits for its email to be verified

providerSignedIn.note: What Example ID answers after a sign-in, as an event: { account, name }. Scenarios play it.

providerFailed.note: What Example ID answers when the sign-in fails, as an event: { message }. Scenarios play it.

finishProvider.note: with: email, name. Ignored once cancelled

finishProvider.to: {{merge(find(state.accounts, lower(it.email) == lower(email)), { provider: true, twoStep: false })}}

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.description: Ends the session on this device

signInAgain.note: The first field of the screen: its email

toCreate.note: A new account starts with an empty password, not the one typed to sign in

finishReset.to: {{map(state.accounts, lower(it.email) == lower(state.reset.email) ? merge(it, { password: state.reset.password }) : it)}}

finishSave.to: {{map(state.accounts, lower(it.email) == lower(state.user.email) ? merge(it, { name: trim(state.profile.name), email: trim(state.profile.email) }) : it)}}

finishChange.to: {{map(state.accounts, lower(it.email) == lower(state.user.email) ? merge(it, { password: state.change.password }) : it)}}

setTwoStep.note: with: on. Turning it on first sets up the app and the backup codes

toggleSlow.title: Slow network (demo)
toggleSlow.description: The fake server answers after 800 ms, to see the busy states

passkeySignIn.note: The browser's passkey picker, faked: the accounts on this device that saved one

passkeyDone.note: A passkey is two factors already, so it skips two-step

otherProvider.note: with: name. A made-up provider that always says yes, after a moment

usernameChanged.note: Asks the demo server whether the username is free, once typing stops

finishVerify.note: The email is verified: the account exists

with.message: {{computed.inviteValid ? t('joinedTeam', { name: state.pending.name }) : t('welcome', { name: state.pending.name })}}

applyTwoStep.note: with: on. Saves the switch on the account

applyTwoStep.to: {{map(state.accounts, lower(it.email) == lower(state.user.email) ? merge(it, { twoStep: on }) : it)}}

freshCodes.note: One demo list for everyone: a real service makes random ones and keeps only their hashes

passTwoStep.note: The second step passed: remembers this device when asked, then opens the session

resetTick.note: Each second on the reset screen: the emailed code lasts 10 minutes

stepUp.note: with: then (the action to run). Sensitive changes ask for the password again, unless it was given in the last 2 minutes

confirmReauth.if: {{find(state.accounts, lower(it.email) == lower(state.user.email)).password != '' && find(state.accounts, lower(it.email) == lower(state.user.email)).password != state.reauth.password}}

children.text: {{t('serverError', { kind: state.formError, message: state.providerMessage, provider: computed.providerTitle })}}

{{t(state.codeMode == 'verify' ? 'verifyEmailCaption' : state.codeMode == 'email' ? 'emailCodeCaption' : state.codeMode == 'sms' ? 'smsCaption' : state.codeMode == 'backup' ? 'backupCaption' : 'twoStepCaption', { email: state.pending.email, phone: state.phone })}}
{{state.codeMode == 'backup' ? t('demoBackup', { code: state.backupCodes[0] ?? '—' }) : t('demoCode', { code: state.demoCode })}}
{{state.busy == 'resend' ? computed.busyText : state.resendLeft > 0 ? t('resendIn', { n: state.resendLeft }) : t('resend')}}
